items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: like Taylor, the bass player, he used to cook in the baggage car.

ctx.x: I think -- Barney was telling me about how he was cooking in the baggage car when they had the two cars, one for his traveling and one for the baggage and instruments, and someplace down south, I think he told me, he got a little stove or something, and was cooking in the car, and I think Duke smelled the food and came in and after that Barney said Duke wanted him to do the cooking all the time. Do you remember that?
No, I don't remember. I know he was cooking -- like Taylor, the bass player, he used to cook in the baggage car.
Is that the way everybody ate? I mean, you used the Pullman to sleep in in the south, right? When you stopped in a town, you'd stay in the car, when you weren't on the job.
